messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning a gradual routing-policy update between eu-edge and apac-edge tonight 02:00 UTC. Goal: shift 40% of eu->apac cross-region traffic to apac-edge over 4 steps (10% every 10m). Need deploy owner, smoke checks, and rollback readiness. Planning window: 02:00–03:00 UTC. @marta can you own routing change? @devon can you own smoke checks? @ryan please be ready for rollback. Steps below.

marta: I can own routing. I'll apply weighted policy updates via trafficctl and monitor latencies. I'll post each step when complete. :thumbsup:

devon: I'll run smoke scripts and confirm traces. Quick checklist:
- prod-synth health
- p50/p95 latencies on api-gateway
- KV cache hit rates
I'll post results after each step.

alex: FYI TTLs: current eu-edge DNS TTL=30s. We'll set tmp TTL to 15s 10m before start. Command:
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --change-batch file://route-change.json
```
Also use `trafficctl set-weight --from eu-edge --to apac-edge --weight 10` per step.

ryan: I'll stand by for rollback. If errors at any step, revert weights to previous value and raise pager. Keep a 1:1 list of step IDs.

anika: Can we gate by error-rate? If 5xx > 0.5% for >2m, auto-revert? We should add alert thresholds in grafana.

marta: Added grafana alert: eu->apac error-rate >0.5% sustained 2m -> tag @oncall and post to #eng-oncall.

sre-bot: [deploy-scheduler] scheduled routing update at 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z (1791234567). Webhook: https://ci.internal/jobs/234

devon: Smoke script (short): `curl -sS https://eu.api.redwood.internal/health` expect 200 and json {ok:true}
I'll paste results after each step.

marta: Starting step 1 -> set weight 10%. Posting logs in 5m.

devon: Step1 checks: p50 +8ms, p95 +30ms, no errors, cache hit steady. ok.

marta: Step2 -> 20%. Will wait 10m then check.

devon: Step2 checks: small spike p95 +40ms but within SLOs, no 5xx. ok.

marta: Step3 -> 30%...

ryan: Hold on step3 — I see a 0.8% 5xx bump in apac-edge. Recommend hold and investigate. Reverting to 20% now.

marta: Reverted to 20%. Recording rollback action. @devon can you collect traces for the bump?

devon: Collected traces and uploaded to /logs/1791234567/step3-traces. Looks like new kernel parameter on apac pool causing transient overload. Creating ticket.

alex: Thanks all. Pausing rollout until apac-node pool fixed. We'll re-schedule; next tentative window 03:30 UTC pending fix. I'll file a short post-mortem and update runbook.

sre-bot: [incident-note] routing-change paused at step3 due to apac-edge 5xx spike. Ticket: INF-9876

marta: I'll coordinate the pool fix with infra and ping when ready. Thanks.

alex: Great. We'll reconvene async. If anyone needs to cite the timeline, use thread_ts 1791234567.
